say:1:1623122001:1.text: You came just in time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I need you to look into something.

say:2:1623122002:1.text: There's a puppy down by the docks, ears drooped, pacing in circles. Looks like a sunflower stuck in the shade too long.
say:2:1623122002:1.source_cn: 码头那边有只小狗，一直耷拉着耳朵在那里打转，那样子活像...
